symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: docx_text() dropped characters Word writes as Symbol-font w:sym elements. cth_convert_sym_v8.py maps them to Unicode (Symbol F0B7 •, F0B4 × and the like), Wingdings boxes to "[ ]", and private-use code points U+F0xx the same way; run with its mapping switched off it reproduces the first deposit byte for byte.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.what_changed: Four bullets (Symbol F0B7 -> •, each followed by a tab) restored at the start of lines 2776 and 2777 (the directions to voters of Form 1, ballot paper, in Schedule 3.2) and lines 2930 and 2931 (the claimant's declaration in the form of claim for unclaimed money, Schedule 4.1). A diff against the first deposit shows no other change; the line count is unchanged.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.encodings_affected: none: baseline-2026-11 leaves the ballot paper and the claim form out of scope (Schedule 3.2 ballots and regs 3.30, 6.07 forms; Schedule 4.1 is not encoded)
